By signing this application, the applicant gives his/her:

## Consent to Personal Data Collection and Processing

- Confirms that the information contained in this application and the Annexes hereto is valid, true and
    accurate as of the specified date, and undertakes to notify Central Securities Depository JSC of changes
    in the referred information, if any, within the time limit set in the Rules for Establishing, Maintaining and
    Terminating Business Relations (“the Rules”);
- Gives its unconditional consent to Central Securities Depository JSC for the personal data collection,
processing, storage and distribution, including cross-border transfer, until the termination of business
relations, in accordance with the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan "On Personal Data and their
Protection" and other applicable laws of the Republic of Kazakhstan;
- Confirms that the applicant has received the unconditional consent of the individuals specified herein and
    the Annexes hereto for the collection, processing, storage and distribution, including cross-border transfer,
    by Central Securities Depository JSC of their personal data, until the termination of business relations, in
    accordance with the Law of the Republic of Kazakhstan "On Personal Data and their Protection" and other
    applicable laws of the Republic of Kazakhstan;
- Undertakes to provide all the necessary documents requested by Central Securities Depository JSC to
    ensure compliance with the anti-money laundering (legalization of proceeds of crime) and counter terrorist
    financing laws of the Republic of Kazakhstan;
- Assumes the obligation to meet the conditions and requirements, to perform the duties established by and
    arising from the Code of Rules;
- Assumes the obligation to pay for the services rendered by Central Securities Depository JSC in
    accordance with the Regulations on Tariffs and Fees;
- Gives its unconditional consent to the disclosure of information about the applicant and its activities by
    Central Securities Depository JSC to meet the requirements of applicable law, on the grounds and in the
    manner established by such a law;
- Expressly and unconditionally agrees to the rights of Central Securities Depository JSC stipulated in
Articles 17 and 18 of the Rules for Establishing, Maintaining and Terminating Business Relations (“the
Rules”) as well as to limitations on and exceptions to the rights of Central Securities Depository JSC
stipulated in Article 19 of the Rules for Establishing, Maintaining and Terminating Business Relations;
- Expressly and unconditionally agrees to the rights of the Central Securities Depository’s client stipulated
    in Article 20 of the Rules as well as to the limitations on and exceptions to the rights of the Central
    Securities Depository’s client stipulated in Article 21 of the Rules;
- Expressly and unconditionally agrees to the liability imposed on Central Securities Depository JSC under
    Article 22 of the Rules as well as to the limitations on and exceptions to the liability of Central Securities
    Depository JSC stipulated in Article 23 of the Rules;
- Expressly and unconditionally agrees to the liability imposed on the Central Securities Depository’s client
    under Article 24 of the Rules;
- Confirms that the applicant has read the terms and conditions of the agreement (i.e., the Code of Rules),
    understands their meaning and unconditionally accepts them.
